note: Authored from the rule text alone, before any producer ran. Each rule has a violating and a clean fixture. Design rule, pre-registered: the violating fixture must violate the rule under any reasonable reading, and the clean fixture must satisfy it under any reasonable reading. A file value of null deletes the default file. event_patch is deep-merged into the default event. The harness dumps every materialised tree to results/materialised/ so the merge is inspectable.

# payments-api

Session and payment endpoints for the Acme storefront.

## Installation

```bash
python -m venv .venv
pip install -e .
```

## Usage

```bash
python -m src.api.handler
```
